title: It's a pause, not a verdict

beats.vo: If your body switches off for a minute, it's not over.

beats.vo: Nerves can make your body's response come and go. That's your body reacting to pressure, not failing you.

beats.vo: Don't stop and apologize. Slow down, stay close, and keep your attention on her.
